basis: exploratory runs on 24- and 28-bit curves (m24/m28 probes): c = 1.0 best or tied at T = 1000; those curves are excluded from the evaluation
arms: ic_solve summands 3 x T (extrapolated from the median of 5 single solves)
idealised multi-target rho = rho_single * sqrt(T) (favourable to rho, unmeasured)
